refresh_minutes.label: Refresh interval (minutes)
refresh_minutes.description: How often the usage API is queried.

window.label: Limit window
window.description: Which usage window the bar shows.

display_mode.label: Show details
display_mode.description: When the time to reset, tokens and bar are shown.
display_mode.important: Only when usage is high (above the warning threshold)
display_mode.hover: Only on hover (icon or ring otherwise)

logo.label: Icon
logo.description: Shown before the text. The ring fills with the remaining (or used) share of the limit.

logo_path.label: Custom image
logo_path.description: SVG or PNG. Empty means logo.svg in the plugin folder.

show_prefix.label: Show 5h / 7d labels
show_prefix.description: Prefix each percentage with its window.

show_bar.label: Show progress bar
show_bar.description: A small bar next to the percentage.

gauge_mode.label: Bar and ring show
gauge_mode.description: What the progress bar and the usage ring fill with.

show_reset.label: Show time to reset
show_reset.description: Time left until the window resets.

ready_text.label: Text when no reset is pending
ready_text.description: Shown instead of a countdown when the window is not running. Empty = "ready" in your language.

show_tokens.label: Show tokens used
show_tokens.description: Tokens used in the window (input + output + cache creation, from local transcripts).

include_cache_read.label: Include cache reads
include_cache_read.description: Add tokens read from the prompt cache. They are cheap but numerous, so the number gets much larger.

dim_extras.label: Dim time and tokens
dim_extras.description: Show the time to reset and the tokens in a muted colour; only the percentage keeps the usage colour.

color_by_usage.label: Colour by usage
color_by_usage.description: Switch to the warning / critical colours above the thresholds.

color.label: Text colour
color.description: Colour role or hex colour for normal usage.

click_command.label: Click command
click_command.description: Shell command run on left click, e.g. alacritty -e claude.

command.label: Click command
command.description: Command run when the icon is clicked.

animation_ms.label: Hover animation (ms)
animation_ms.description: How long the details take to slide out and fade in. 0 turns the animation off.

percent_decimals.label: Decimal places in percentages
percent_decimals.description: 0 rounds to whole numbers. The API currently reports whole percentages, so decimals usually show .0.

launch_command.label: Claude Code command
launch_command.description: Terminal command the panel uses to start Claude Code; the chosen --model and mode are appended.

click_action.label: Left click
click_action.description: What a left click on the widget does. Right click always refreshes.

panel_translucent.label: Translucent panel
panel_translucent.description: Let the wallpaper show through the panel background; the text stays fully opaque.

show_cost.label: Show cost at API prices
show_cost.description: Estimated cost of the window's tokens at Anthropic API list prices. With a Claude subscription you do not pay per token - this shows what the same usage would cost on the API.

error.no_credentials: Not logged in to Claude Code
error.token_expired: Token expired - use Claude Code once to refresh

panel.no_models: No usage in this window yet.
